description: GO annotation provenance audit for CG14717 (Q9VGJ4), CG2059 (Q9W3R8) and human ABHD11 (Q8NFV4): pull every QuickGO record with evidence code and with/from field, save the table to provenance, and draw the annotation-transfer graph showing that every molecular-function and localization claim on CG14717 is inherited rather than measured
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

ACC = {"Q9VGJ4":"CG14717 (fly)","Q9W3R8":"CG2059 (fly)","Q8NFV4":"ABHD11 (human)"}
rows=[]
for acc,name in ACC.items():
    u=("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search?geneProductId="
       f"{acc}&limit=200&includeFields=goName")
    r=requests.get(u,headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=60)
    js=r.json()
    for a in js.get("results",[]):
        if a.get("geneProductId","").split(":")[-1]!=acc:  # only direct records
            continue
        rows.append(dict(acc=acc,protein=name,go=a.get("goId"),
                         term=a.get("goName"), aspect=a.get("goAspect"),
                         evidence=a.get("goEvidence"), qualifier=a.get("qualifier"),
                         ref=a.get("reference"),
                         withfrom=";".join(c.get("id","") for w in (a.get("withFrom") or [])
                                           for c in w.get("connectedXrefs",[])),
                         by=a.get("assignedBy")))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates()
df.to_csv("go_provenance_CG14717_CG2059_ABHD11.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",46)
for acc,name in ACC.items():
    sub=df[df.acc==acc][["go","term","aspect","evidence","qualifier","ref","withfrom"]]
    print("="*110); print(name,acc,"  n =",len(sub))
    print(sub.to_string(index=False))

# ---- does CG14717 carry ANY annotation from the ABPP activity atlas (PMID 33827210)? ----
print("\nRecords citing PMID:33827210 ->",
      df[df.ref.astype(str).str.contains("33827210")][["protein","go","term","evidence"]].to_string(index=False))
print("Records citing PMID:22198472 ->",
      df[df.ref.astype(str).str.contains("22198472")][["protein","go","term","evidence"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---------------- figure: annotation provenance graph ----------------

ax.axis("off")
box=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5",linewidth=1.4)
# nodes
nodes={
 "CG2059":(0.13,0.78,"#cfe8cf","CG2059 / Q9W3R8\nDrosophila paralog\nSer127 present"),

}
for k,(x,y,c,lab) in nodes.items():
    ax.text(x,y,lab,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,
            bbox=dict(box,facecolor=c,edgecolor="#555"))
# measured evidence on the donors
ax.text(0.13,0.955,"measured evidence",ha="center",fontsize=10,style="italic",color="#2b6b2b")
ax.text(0.13,0.905,"GO:0106435 carboxylesterase  IDA  PMID 22198472\n"
                   "GO:0017171 serine hydrolase  HDA  PMID 33827210",
        ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9.2,
